observations: Industrial sewing machine mounted on a white table with a metal stand.
The brand 'EMEL' is printed in red on the left side of the table in photo 0.
The machine head is grey with a black horizontal stripe; a model plate is visible on the right but the text is illegible.
A thread stand with two spool pins is attached, holding one green spool of thread.
A foot pedal and motor are visible beneath the table.
The image contains watermarks for 'PHREESEW ENT' and 'JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The machine's form factor (zig-zag capable industrial head) is consistent with a manual embroidery machine, but no embroidery work or stitch samples are shown.

risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and sewing through fabric.
A close-up video of the machine sewing a wide zig-zag stitch without skipping.
A photo showing all included accessories and attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the machine head and table only.

proof_requests: A clear, readable photo of the model plate on the right side of the machine head.
A video of the machine running and sewing a zig-zag stitch.
A photo of the motor label under the table to confirm if it is a clutch or servo motor.
Photos of any included embroidery hoops or accessories.
response.reason: The specific model number on the machine head is unreadable, and for industrial machinery, a video of operation is essential to distinguish between a functional tool and a heavy repair project.
